summary: Step 4 email + Google sign-in regression (REQ-342..405, JRN-110..138) at 1440x900 and 390x844 against https://drivepast-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. backend/scripts/step4_mock_check.py re-run: 32/32 PASS. Backend pytest serial (-n 0 -o addopts=''): 82 passed, 3 failed (2 by-design stub tests + 1 flaky from shared ai/config state — passes in isolation). JRN-134 UI: localStorage.clear() + navigate /, /dispatch, /inbox, /units/van-2, /settings all render data-testid signin-screen with brand 'Drivepast', tagline exactly 'Price every job from the van that already drives past.', buttons signin-google-button + signin-demo-button. Clicking 'Open the demo' from / lands at /dispatch (Fleet) in one click, sets localStorage dp-demo-open=1, reload stays inside app. topbar-owner reads 'Rosa Delgado · Owner' in demo mode. GET /api/auth/google/start → 302 to accounts.google.com with client_id=275593578414-1thu6bribet6mqodtuhrv273e1v3osmq..., redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fdrivepast.preview.emergentagent.com%2Fapi%2Fauth%2Fgoogle%2Fcallback, scope=openid+email+profile+gmail.readonly+gmail.send+spreadsheets.readonly, access_type=offline, prompt=consent. Nothing was connected." /settings in demo mode shows settings-email-google section with google-status 'Not connected' and google-sign-in-button visible; /settings?google=failed also shows data-testid google-failed with the same text. POST /api/dev/test-session returns 404 (DEV_TEST_SESSION_ENABLED off by design). Inbox: no gmail-bar when Google not connected. JRN-81/82/83 via API: POST /demo/reset → /inbox/req-01/ask-vans builds 2 cards (van-2 $11, van-1 $14) → /inbox/req-01/send with option_id 950e24... creates quote (customer phone line matches wording) → POST /demo/customer-accept flips to 'accepted' and van-2 timeline grows 20→22 → POST /engine/undo returns ok:true removed_stop_keys and van-2 timeline back to 20. REQ-395: PUT /api/ai/config secret='sk-test-abcd1234' → GET /ai/config returns secret_masked='saved', '1234' nowhere in body; PUT clear_secret:true → secret_set=false, secret_masked='' . JRN-133 regression: POST /engine/run-all returns req-01 winner=van-2 price=11.0 arrival_label=1:54pm (quoted — Van 2 pass_by 1:50pm matches journey copy); req-04 shifted deadline_later → Van 4 pickup 4:15pm $35 (floor); req-08 shifted deadline_later → Van 1 delivery arrival_label=9:44am $55 (within rounding of 9:45am stated in journey). Fleet/van/optimizer/street-line routes untouched.

minor.issue: Flaky in full-suite run (-n 0): once reported 'Saved, not connected yet' instead of 'Not set up yet' due to a prior test leaving an AI secret saved and demo/reset not clearing /api/ai/config. Passes cleanly in isolation. Suggest having POST /api/demo/reset also wipe ai_config, or make test_jrn11_connection_rows PUT clear_secret:true in its own setup.

action_items: Optional: make /api/demo/reset also clear /api/ai/config (secret, base_url, model) so test_jrn11_connection_rows is stable in full-suite runs — currently it's the only flaky test and only in -n 0 after the mocked step4 suite seeds a saved secret.
critical_code_review_comments: No new code issues observed. AuthGate / QuotePage split keeps /q/<token> correctly outside the sign-in gate (verified for both valid and invalid tokens). google_api.py start-url builds the exact client_id, redirect_uri, scope, access_type and prompt required by JRN-138. REQ-395 is honoured: /api/ai/config never emits any character of the saved secret — only secret_masked='saved' or '' and secret_set boolean.
Minor: 2026-10-24 journey req-08 copy says 9:45am but engine returns arrival_label 9:44am (same rounding note as iteration_8). Still within tolerance.

Minor: pytest default addopts in /app/backend/pytest.ini still parallelises via xdist; must be invoked with '-n 0 -o addopts=\'\'' because the suites share demo + ai/config state. Consider making -n 0 the default or acquiring a DB-level lock.

success_rate.backend: 97% (82/85; 2 by-design stub failures + 1 flaky state-pollution failure that passes in isolation)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on JRN-134, JRN-137, JRN-138, Settings email-google, Inbox no-gmail-bar, topbar-owner, 390px no horizontal scroll

test_credentials: No login. 'Open the demo' (data-testid signin-demo-button) or localStorage.setItem('dp-demo-open','1'). Google client is Testing mode — automated consent not possible. POST /api/dev/test-session is 404 (DEV_TEST_SESSION_ENABLED off by design).
seed_data_creation: Used built-in Bayline seed; POST /api/demo/reset called before JRN-81/82/83 and JRN-133 checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run step4 mock: `cd /app/backend && python scripts/step4_mock_check.py` → 32/32. Backend pytest: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -n 0 -o addopts='' --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/<name>.xml` (xdist breaks shared demo/ai state). The 2 stand-in tests (TestStubLLM::test_stub_connect_and_read_tags_our_model, TestStandInLabel) fail by design — DEV_STUB_ENABLED=false. test_jrn11_connection_rows is flaky in full-suite order after test_step4_email_mock saves a secret; passes in isolation. For UI, demo entry: await page.goto(BASE+'/'); await page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('dp-demo-open','1')"); then goto app pages. The Customer-phone accept uses POST /api/demo/customer-accept {quote_key:<quote-xxxx>} (not /api/q/<token>/accept which is public endpoint). /api/engine/undo (POST, no body) is the single undo. /api/auth/google/callback?error=access_denied → 302 /settings?google=failed. /signin?google=failed shows data-testid signin-message; /settings?google=failed shows data-testid google-failed with the same copy. topbar-owner shows 'RD\nRosa Delgado · Owner' in demo mode; topbar-sign-out requires a real session and is absent in demo mode (expected).
rca of the issue: test_jrn11_connection_rows flake: /api/demo/reset preserves /api/ai/config state. test_step4_email_mock stores an AI secret as part of its journey, which flips our_model.detail from 'Not set up yet' to 'Saved, not connected yet'. When the two suites run in the same process, order-dependence surfaces. Fix is a one-liner either in demo_reset (also clear ai_config) or in test_jrn11 setup (PUT /api/ai/config {clear_secret:true}).
